This is an independent semantic data excerpt. It exercises the same fleet CSV
SPLIT, field conversion, owned typed rows, and total calculation as the frozen
interactive report. Its input rows are constants; it contains no picker,
upload, selection screen, or SALV calls. It is NOT an oracle execution of the
unchanged complete zfleet_csv_alv.abap report or a claim of SAP GUI equivalence.

The complete excerpt bytes execute unchanged on the preinstalled pinned
@abaplint/transpiler and @abaplint/runtime 2.14.8, using Node v22.23.3 and
research/native-abap/itab-reference.mjs. Both package versions were checked
before execution. No dependency installation or pin change was performed.
The JSON binds exact source SHA-256, provider, complete report entry, every
report DATA object, output, and three SY fields. Tests reject changed source.

The separate salv-model fixtures specify this project's bounded TUI grid;
that independent model does not execute or claim to emulate SAP SALV visuals.
